title: The 2 Best Countertop Ice Makers Under $100
h1: The 2 Best Countertop Ice Makers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for countertop ice makers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop ice makers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Igloo Automatic Self-Cleaning Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of ice per 24 hours, 9 cubes ready in about 7 minutes, Automatic 5-cycle self-cleaning function.
strengths: Self-cleaning cycle is unusual at this price point and genuinely reduces maintenance
Compact footprint fits most small kitchens or bar carts
limitations: 1-quart reservoir needs daily refilling with regular use
Plastic housing feels basic compared to stainless steel options
Bullet-style ice melts faster than nugget ice
features: Large or small cube size selector

products.name: Frigidaire Countertop Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day, 9 pieces ready in about 7 minutes, Black stainless finish.
strengths: Usually the lowest price of any 26 lb/day machine on the market
Recognized appliance brand with wide replacement part and support availability
Black stainless finish looks more premium than the price suggests
limitations: No self-cleaning function, needs manual descaling
Fan noise is noticeable in a quiet room
features: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
